standard-dialogue.text: If the player has experience to claim:

steps.npc: It seems you're missing out on some valuable experience. Would you like it?

steps.text: You are owed the following: [list of experience the player can claim]

standard-dialogue.text: If the player does not have experience to claim:

steps.npc: Hello. I've found some stuff that I think is yours. You can pay me with cash you're carrying, or I can take payments from your bank. Would you like to buy anything from me?

standard-dialogue.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: Why do you charge for returning lost items?

steps.player: Why do you charge for returning lost items?

steps.npc: You could get your stuff back elsewhere, sure. Now, maybe it'd be free, or maybe you'd have to pay someone, but you'd definitely have to go on a journey to get it back.
So I'm earning my fee by saving you a trip. Do you want to have a look?

steps.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: About items that break when people kill me...

steps.player: About items that break when people kill me...

steps.npc: Oh yes, some items do break specially when you're killed by your rivals. And if you die in the deep Wilderness, they vanish altogether.
For a fee, yes. Just show me the broken item.

options.text: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?

steps.player: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?

steps.npc: I can lock them to you so they won't vanish on death in deep Wilderness, yes. I'll want some money for my services, though, and you'll need to bring me a Trouver Parchment.

steps.text: If the player does not have a parchment in their inventory:
Perdu tells you about a merchant in Ferox Enclave who sells special scrolls called Trouver Parchments.

steps.npc: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item you want to lock.

steps.text: If the player does have a parchment in their inventory:

steps.npc: Not bad for a human! Okay, show me the item you want to protect, and I'll see what I can do.

using-items-on-perdu-lockable-without-pa.npc: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness, but I'll need a Trouver parchment.

using-items-on-perdu-lockable-without-pa.text: Perdu tells you about a merchant in Ferox Enclave who sells special scrolls called Trouver Parchments.

using-items-on-perdu-lockable-without-pa.npc: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item again.

using-items-on-perdu-lockable-with-parch.npc: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness. It'll cost you 500,000 coins and a Trouver parchment.
I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness. It'll cost you 500,000 coins and a Trouver parchment.
However be warned that the lock will NOT cover the ornament kit on your item. That kit will be lost.
I see that at least one of the items I locked has an ornament kit. I will remind you that the lock does NOT cover the ornament kit, only the base item. Liability and all that.

using-items-on-perdu-locked.npc: I've locked that item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness. I can unlock it again, returning your parchment and 475,000 coins.

steps.text: Perdu unlocks your item and returns the parchment and some money.

using-items-on-perdu-parchment.npc: If you want me to lock an item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness, show me the item.

using-items-on-perdu-breakable-item-that.npc: You don't need me to lock that item, it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness.

using-items-on-perdu-coins.npc: I can see you have some money. Weird flex, but okay.

using-items-on-perdu-other-items.npc: I can't help you with that item - it's not the kind of thing I could lock or repair, if you were hoping for me to do that sort of thing.

reclaiming-destroyed-echo-boots.npc: I have something for you. You lost your Echo boots. Would you like it back?

pvp-bounty-hunter-world-banner-dialogue.npc: Ah! I have something for you. You lost your banner. Would you like it back?

deadman-mode-with-an-active-breach.npc: You seem lost, but luckily I know where to send you. A breach is occurring [location 1] (single). Another breach is occuring [location 2] (multi).
